Professional AC Duct Repair in Alamo Heights

AC ducts play a key role in keeping your home comfortable. When ducts are dirty, clogged, or damaged, your air conditioner can’t distribute cool air properly. This leads to uneven temperatures and may even raise your energy bills. At Rosenberg Plumbing & Air, we address these issues with a clear, step-by-step process that gets your system back on track.

We start by inspecting your ductwork to see exactly what’s wrong. Our technicians are trained to spot issues like leaks, blockages, or damage from debris buildup. Once we’ve identified the problem, we get right to work. Depending on what we find, our repair process may involve sealing small leaks, cleaning out blockages, or patching damaged sections of ductwork. Every repair is done with one goal in mind: restoring proper airflow so your AC doesn’t have to work overtime.
